name: Alexis Ortega
bio:
When I’m not working, you’ll usually find me traveling the world or spending time with my beautiful family, whether it’s going to the gym together or helping one another keep up with our busy lifestyle. I strive to bring the same energy into my work that I bring into everyday life.

Real estate became a natural path for me as a builder’s wife. Learning this industry, I gained valuable insight into quality and what truly makes a house feel like home. More than anything, I love the opportunity to make a meaningful and lasting impact on people’s lives by helping them step confidently into a new chapter.

Serving Ascension Parish and the surrounding areas, I specialize in residential real estate, new construction and investment properties. One of the most rewarding parts of my career is seeing my clients genuinely happy and accomplished, whether they are buying their first home, upgrading, investing, or selling.
